title: VERA: A Responsible AI Dashboard for Assessing LLM Deployments in Light of the EU AI Act
abstract: arXiv:2610.31588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Institutions that deploy large language models in regulated settings often need technical evidence of responsible AI practices before approving a deployment. COMPL-AI provides a technical interpretation of the EU AI Act that organises this evidence under six principle groups and eighteen technical requirements, twelve of which current benchmarks can measure. The benchmark suites that produce this evidence are typically operated from a command line, while the staff who approve deployments are non-engineers. We present VERA, an open-source self-hosted dashboard deployed to facilitate responsible AI processes within a large European bank. A reviewer selects a model and runs public benchmarks against it. VERA scores the twelve requirements that current benchmarks can measure and instruments the energy consumed by each evaluation, adding run-level evidence for environmental impact. translated_title: VERA：基于欧盟人工智能法案评估大语言模型部署的负责任人工智能仪表盘
translated_abstract: 在受监管环境中部署大语言模型的机构，在批准一项部署之前，通常需要关于负责任人工智能实践的技术证据。COMPL-AI 提供了对欧盟人工智能法案的一种技术解读，将这些证据组织为六大原则组下的十八项技术要求，其中十二项可以由当前的基准测试来衡量。然而，产生这些证据的基准测试套件通常需要通过命令行操作，而负责批准部署的工作人员并非工程师。我们提出了 VERA，一个开源的自托管仪表盘，已部署于一家大型欧洲银行以促进其负责任人工智能流程。审查员只需选择一个模型并对其运行公开的基准测试。VERA 会对当前基准测试可衡量的十二项技术要求进行评分，并测量每次评估所消耗的能源，为环境影响提供运行级别的证据。我们让四个已部署服务的开源权重模型通过了相关要求……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: VERA 是一个开源自托管仪表盘，让非技术审查人员能够便捷地对大语言模型运行合规基准测试，依据欧盟人工智能法案对十二项可衡量的技术要求进行评分，并追踪评估过程的能耗，已实际部署于一家大型欧洲银行。
en_tdlr: VERA is an open-source, self-hosted dashboard that enables non-engineering reviewers to run compliance benchmarks on LLMs, scoring twelve measurable EU AI Act technical requirements and tracking evaluation energy consumption, with a real deployment at a large European bank.
